children: said Thursday its board expects to complete a review of plans to split into two ‌publicly-traded companies - utility and pipeline, and upstream and gathering -

would be a 100% rate-regulated company with natural gas utility and interstate pipeline and storage assets across Pennsylvania, Ohio, and New York, while the Integrated Upstream and Gathering business would become an independent public company focused solely on its highly integrated, Appalachian upstream and gathering natural gas business.

"With the expected closing of our Ohio gas utility acquisition next month, each business will be a scaled platform with distinct strategic priorities, organic growth opportunities, capital needs, and investment profiles," CEO David Bauer said.
shareholders would own shares in both National Fuel and the Integrated Upstream and Gathering business.
